equity.level_reason: Rates are reported by rurality and sex and differences described (rural higher), but values are set side by side with no computed contrast and no disparity framing, so level 2.

level_alternative.reason: Urban-rural status could be read as geography rather than social position.

Males had higher death rates than females in both rural and urban areas.

equity.equity_measurement: Rurality is the OMB 2013 MSA delineation, dichotomized (areas <50,000 inhabitants rural); rates are crude, not age-adjusted.

notes: The 2×2 sex × rurality cells are compared one margin at a time (rural vs urban within sex; male vs female within area), so no groupwise entry. 'Higher' claims are not tied to a stated test; CIs are shown only as error bars.
